items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: Benchmark indices faced a volatile session due to profit booking and investor caution before US inflation data. Analysts indicated that the index needs to create higher highs and lows to signal a potential recovery. While India VIX rose, the Nasdaq ended lower following disappointing inflation data that raised interest rate concerns. Foreign institutional investors net sold shares, while domestic institutions were net buyers on Wednesday.

items.title: Stocks in news: Reliance Industries, Jio Financial, Tata Tech, HDB Financial and Wipro
items.description: Indian equity benchmarks ended lower after a volatile session influenced by strong wholesale inflation and elevated crude oil prices. The Nifty 50 declined, testing the support zone of 22,580-22,620, which might weaken with repeated tests. Several companies, such as Reliance Industries and Tata Technologies, are expected to be in focus due to upcoming quarterly earnings.

items.title: Insurance, NPS equity investments plunge 45% to Rs 22,714 crore in September quarter
items.description: Insurance companies and NPS funds have decreased their combined investments in Indian equities by 45%. They invested ₹22,714 crore in the September quarter, compared to ₹41,465 crore prior. Higher bond yields and declining stock prices have shifted their focus towards debt instruments. Mutual funds, on the other hand, continue to invest heavily in equities this quarter.

items.title: Sebi confirms interim curbs on Rajesh Exports, promoter over alleged fund routing
items.description: Sebi has imposed interim restrictions on Rajesh Exports and its promoter Rajesh Mehta for alleged financial misrepresentation. The regulator found issues regarding the reported consolidated revenue of ₹15.4 lakh crore. Rajesh Exports' standalone revenue reported by its subsidiary Valcambi SA was significantly lower at ₹3,027.3 crore. Despite opportunities to respond, the company and promoter failed to adequately rebut Sebi’s preliminary findings.

items.title: Fairfax's IDBI deal premium justified by strategic fit, scale: Analysts
items.description: Analysts believe this acquisition holds considerable potential, greatly enhancing Fairfax's branch network and deposit portfolio in India, paving the way for a diversified financial ecosystem.

items.title: Fairfax offers plan to resolve IDBI-CSB ownership overlapping
items.description: A merger of the two lenders is emerging as the most likely option, potentially allowing the Canadian investor to consolidate its banking interests under a single licence, sources said.

items.title: BHEL shares fall 4% despite Q2 profit jumping 119% YoY. Should you buy, sell or hold?
items.description: BHEL shares fell 4.3% after rallying on strong Q2FY27 results, even as Nuvama and JM Financial retained their Buy ratings and raised target prices. Brokerages cited margin expansion, improved execution, a healthy order book and favourable thermal power prospects.

items.title: 8 Nifty stocks delivered negative returns over 5 years. Do you own any?
items.description: The Indian stock market has seen a sharp upturn but an equally sharp downturn over the past five years, pushing many of India’s most trusted bluechip stocks sharply lower as Trump’s tariff flipflops, Middle East war, falling rupee, surging bond yields and sharp FII outflows weighed. Here are 8 Nifty 50 stocks that have delivered negative returns over the past five years.

items.title: Why is market rising today? Sensex rallies over 1,000 pts, Nifty above 22,900. 4 major factors behind the surge
items.description: Benchmark indices Nifty and Sensex experienced a rebound on Thursday following the previous day's decline. Strong performances by IT and banking stocks contributed to positive sentiment on Dalal Street. Volatility increased as the India VIX rose over 1%, reflecting market fluctuations. Oil prices also fell as investors reacted to geopolitical tensions and easing sanctions on vessels.

items.title: Largecaps are shrinking, smallcaps are getting bigger: What is changing in India’s stock market?
items.description: The Indian stock market is witnessing a notable transformation as large-cap stocks are losing ground amidst changing capital flows and investor sentiment. Mid- and small-cap companies are surging ahead, capturing more market capitalization as domestic institutional investors pivot towards these segments. As large-caps endure foreign selling pressures, the contrast in performance underscores a shift in market dynamics. Future outcomes will hinge on whether earnings growth aligns with current valuations.

items.title: Beware! Blind investing in smallcaps won’t make you money as 148 of 250 stocks tumble in 2026
items.description: More than half of the Nifty 250 stocks have delivered negative returns in 2026 despite the index gaining over 7%. Experts flag elevated valuations and persistent FII selling, stressing selective stock picking as earnings growth and performance diverge across market segments.

items.title: Tata Tech shares rally 8% after Q2 results, but Goldman Sachs and JM Financial stay bearish. Here's why
items.description: Tata Technologies shares surged after reporting a 4% YoY rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 171 crore. Revenue grew 28% to Rs 1,699 crore, led by a 34% jump in services revenue to Rs 1,356 crore. EBITDA rose 32% to Rs 273 crore, with margins expanding 40 bps to 16.1%. Services revenue grew 4.3% sequentially in constant currency terms to $142 million.

items.title: LIC Housing Finance among 4 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of October 14, four stocks in the NSE F&O segment recorded an increase of more than 7% in futures open interest compared with the previous trading session, according to StockEdge F&O scan data. A notable increase in futures open interest indicates a rise in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a security. This may reflect market participants initiating new positions or increasing their existing positions.

items.title: Bonfiglioli Transmissions IPO opens for subscription; GMP at 30%: Should you subscribe?
items.description: Bonfiglioli Transmissions IPO opened for subscription on October 15, 2026, aiming to raise Rs 2,533.66 crore via an offer for sale. The price band is set at Rs 558-586 per share with a 30% grey market premium. Anand Rathi has recommended a "Subscribe for Long Term" rating.

items.title: Rainbow Children's Medicare among 4 stocks that closed crossing above VWAP
items.description: On October 14, the closing prices of four stocks in the Nifty 500 pack were more than 1.5% above their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Price), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. When the closing price is above the VWAP, it means the stock closed at a price higher than its volume-weighted average traded price during the day. The VWAP gives greater weight to prices at which higher trading volumes occurred.

items.title: Vedanta Power among 6 stocks showing RSI trending up
items.description: On October 14, six stocks from the Nifty500 pack that gained over 5% appeared in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.The scan identifies stocks whose RSI values have crossed above 50 from below, indicating strengthening momentum. The Relative Strength Index is a technical indicator commonly used by traders to assess price momentum and trend strength.

items.title: Paytm shares get new Buy rating after Nomura initiates coverage. 3 reasons behind bullish call
items.description: Nomura has initiated coverage on Paytm with a Buy rating and a target price of Rs 2,250, implying an upside of 31%. The brokerage expects EBITDA to grow at a 96% CAGR over FY26-29F, driven by payments, merchant lending, AI-led cost efficiencies and potential UPI MDR revenue. International expansion and enterprise AI product Pi offer additional growth opportunities.

items.title: Reliance Industries shares in focus as Jio IPO sets price band for possibly biggest-ever issue. What shareholders must know
items.description: Reliance Industries shares will be in focus after Jio Platforms announced its IPO price band of Rs 1,065-1,119 per share. The Rs 30,213 crore issue includes a shareholder reservation for eligible RIL investors and could become India's largest IPO.

items.title: JSW Energy among 4 stocks showing White Marubozu pattern
items.description: On October 14, four Nifty500 stocks appeared on StockEdge’s White Marubozu bullish scanner.A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in which the opening price is the lowest and the closing price is the highest for the period. It is represented by a long white or green candlestick with no upper shadow and little or no lower shadow, reflecting strong upward price momentum during the session.

items.title: 950% rally in 6 months! Last day to buy this multibagger microcap stock before reverse stock split. What this mean for investors?
items.description: As the name suggests, it is exactly the opposite of what a stock split does. While a stock split divides shares into multiple shares, a reverse stock split consolidates multiple shares into fewer shares.

items.title: Hyundai Motor to invest $15.5 billion in India by 2032
items.description: Hyundai Motor Group announced plans to invest $15.5 billion in India from 2023 to 2032. This investment aims to enhance manufacturing operations and support growth in the automotive sector. The group recognizes India's importance as a strategic market for future mobility. As part of the investment, Hyundai will also focus on research and development activities and infrastructure enhancement.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 6 midcap stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the NSE midcap pack, six stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200-day moving averages (DMA) on October 14, 2026, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. The 200-day moving average (DMA) is used by traders as a key indicator for determining the overall trend of a stock. As long as a stock's price remains above its 200-day moving average on the daily timeframe, it is generally interpreted as being in an overall uptrend.

items.title: Volume Shocker: MFs add 1 crore+ shares to 5 stocks in September; shares tumble up to 43%
items.description: In its latest mutual fund analysis, ETMarkets identified stocks that saw the sharpest increase in mutual fund holdings in September 2026 compared with August. The analysis found that mutual fund houses collectively added more than 1 crore shares each in 45 stocks, highlighting significant institutional accumulation during the month.To dig deeper, an additional filter was applied to identify stocks that combined strong mutual fund accumulation with positive price momentum. This screening focused on stocks that gained 10% to 20% from the beginning of September through the latest available date, throwing up three standout performers. On the other hand, five major laggards whose shares tumbled between 15% and 43% over the same period were also spotlighted, underscoring the divergence between institutional buying activity and stock price performance.Interestingly, Vodafone Idea and Swiggy topped the list of stocks that witnessed the biggest net additions to mutual fund holdings in September 2026. Mutual funds added a net 18.34 crore shares of Vodafone Idea and 13.67 crore shares of Swiggy. However, despite this substantial accumulation, both stocks remained under pressure, declining by more than 10% each since the beginning of September. (Data Source: ACE MF, ACE Equity)

items.title: Jio IPO fever grips telecom stocks: Airtel, Vodafone Idea & others rise up to 4%
items.description: Telecom stocks rose sharply on as investors focused on Jio Platforms’ upcoming IPO and its implications for sector valuations. Nomura estimates Jio’s equity value at Rs 9.8 lakh crore to Rs 10.3 lakh crore, while its analysis suggests Bharti Airtel trades at a discount despite stronger subscriber trends and tariff-hike prospects.

items.title: Redington could gain as memory shortage reshapes ICT distribution; brokerage sees 20% upside
items.description: DAM Capital has re-initiated coverage on Redington with a Buy rating and a target price of Rs 470, implying nearly 20% upside. The brokerage sees the memory shortage, distributor consolidation and software growth supporting revenue expansion and improving returns.

items.title: Rs 82,500 crore rally in 3 days: Why TCS, HCL Tech, other IT stocks jumped up to 12% in 3 days and will the boom last?
items.description: Indian IT stocks have rebounded sharply. The Nifty IT index has risen 8%, adding Rs 82,500 crore to the sector’s market capitalisation. The rebound follows a selloff in global AI-linked stocks driven by concerns over stretched valuations, concentration risks and uncertain returns on heavy AI investments.

items.title: IDBI Bank shares fall 7% as investors book profit after Fairfax deal gets cabinet nod
items.description: IDBI Bank shares plunged as investors booked profits after a nearly 13% rally in the previous session following the Cabinet’s approval of Fairfax’s acquisition of a 60.72% stake in the lender. The stock had hit Rs 93.60 on Wednesday, lifting its market capitalisation above Rs 1 lakh crore. The Rs 52,878 crore deal marks a major step in IDBI Bank’s long-awaited privatisation, with Fairfax’s bid of Rs 81 per share exceeding the independent valuers’ average fair value of Rs 75.99.

items.title: Ready for take-off? Analysts map the flight path for India's aerospace stocks
items.description: India's aerospace sector is poised for multi-year growth, driven by rising aircraft production, defence spending, exports and global supply-chain diversification. Analysts highlight HAL, Data Patterns, Azad Engineering, MTAR Technologies and Unimech Aerospace, while flagging execution risks and elevated valuations.

items.title: From Rs 1,000 in 1977 to Rs 52 lakh today: The Reliance wealth story behind Jio’s Rs 10.3 lakh crore valuation in mega IPO
items.description: A Rs 1,000 investment in Reliance Industries’ 1977 IPO could be worth nearly Rs 52 lakh today, including shares received through the Jio Financial Services demerger. As Jio Platforms prepares for its Rs 30,200 crore IPO at a Rs 10.3 lakh crore valuation, investors will assess its growth prospects and pricing.

items.title: Top 10 PMS portfolios that delivered up to 7% returns in September. See full list
items.description: Benchmark indices Nifty and Sensex endured a sharp sell-off in September, falling more than 6% each as escalating tensions in the Middle East, soaring oil prices and bond yields hitting multi-decade highs rattled investor sentiment. Data from PMS Bazaar showed that while several portfolios struggled to contain losses, small-cap and SME-focused strategies stood out on the other side of the performance table, delivering some of September's strongest returns.

items.title: Canara Bank shares slide over 6% after Q2 earnings. Buy, sell or hold the state lender?
items.description: Canara Bank shares fell sharply on Thursday despite reporting an 8% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 standalone net profit to Rs 5,175 crore. Brokerages remain divided, with Morgan Stanley retaining an Underweight rating, while Motilal Oswal and JM Financial recommend buying the stock.

items.title: Cemindia Projects’ Rs 1,400-crore QIP oversubscribed 2.3x; Edelweiss Life, Nuvama, Motilal MF among investors
items.description: Cemindia Projects raised Rs 1,400 crore through a qualified institutional placement priced at Rs 1,108 per share, attracting 2.3 times demand over the base issue. Leading mutual funds participated as the company secured strong credit ratings and shares rallied.

items.title: Two Trades for Today: A financial services company for a 7.2% rise, a mid-cap realty stock for a 6.35% upmove
items.description: Our technical analysts identify select stocks every trading day that may gain momentum even in volatile markets. Here are the technical calls for today.

items.title: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts among 4 stocks hitting 52-week highs; rally up to 32% in a month
items.description: Benchmark Sensex surged 1,533 points to close at 74,315. Amid the broader market rally, four stocks from the BSE 500 index touched fresh 52-week highs, reaching their highest price levels in the past year. A 52-week high marks the highest price at which a stock has traded over the previous 12 months and may indicate heightened investor interest and trading activity.

items.title: Weekly Top Picks: These stocks scored 10 on 10 on Stock Reports Plus
items.description: Stock Reports Plus, powered by Refinitiv, undertakes detailed company analysis for 4,000+ listed stocks. In addition to detailed company analyses, the report also collates analysts’ forecasts and trend analysis for each component. An average score in Stock Reports Plus is calculated by undertaking quantitative analysis of five key investment tools – earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum.

items.title: Nilesh Shah on PSU privatisation: How Hindustan Zinc offers a lesson for IDBI Bank
items.description: Kotak AMC’s Nilesh Shah cited Hindustan Zinc as an example of how strategic divestment combined with a retained minority stake can create long-term national wealth. He said the government’s remaining stake is now worth over Rs 62,000 crore and expressed hope that IDBI Bank’s divestment would deliver similar value.

items.title: How Akash, Isha Ambani’s missed college assignment led to the creation of Rs 10 lakh crore Jio
items.description: A failed college assignment by Isha Ambani helped spark the idea for Jio, which is now preparing for a Rs 30,213 crore IPO at a valuation of around Rs 10.3 lakh crore. Akash Ambani said the proceeds would go towards debt reduction, as Reliance seeks to unlock value from its digital business.

items.title: Long-term investing is about looking beyond narratives, including AI: 5 large-caps with an upside potential of up to 24%
items.description: As we see a recovery in the market, it is good to be cognizant of the fact that more than the narratives on the street, it is the earnings of companies that are extremely important. And earnings are dependent on many factors, including the cyclicality factor.

items.title: Ace investor Sunil Singhania adds 6 new stocks in Q2; likely exits two companies after 150% rally
items.description: Sunil Singhania’s Abakkus funds added six stocks, including Aether Industries, BEML and Paramount Communications, amid market volatility and foreign investor outflows. The funds likely exited Cyient DLM and TTK Healthcare, trimmed other holdings, as Abakkus filed its IPO papers.

items.title: Tata Sons pays Rs 4,475 crore in annual dividends; hypothetical investment could generate Rs 82,000 crore for philanthropy, says Harsh Goenka
items.description: RPG Enterprises Chairman Harsh Goenka shared a hypothetical thought experiment on X regarding Tata Sons. He noted that selling Tata Sons' Rs 11.68 lakh crore listed equity portfolio and reinvesting in 6-7% safe yield instruments could generate up to Rs 82,000 crore annually for philanthropy, compared to its current Rs 4,475 crore dividend.

items.title: Sebi writes to IRDAI to include investors' insurance policy details in consolidated account statement
items.description: Sebi Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey announced efforts to include insurance information in the Consolidated Account Statement. The initiative aims to provide investors with a comprehensive financial overview of their investments. Additionally, RBI's support for integrating bank deposits into the framework is also underway. A comprehensive review of existing regulations is being conducted to improve transparency and ease compliance for businesses.

items.title: Sebi revises CAS rules, changes derivatives expiry settlement methodology
items.description: Sebi has announced changes to the closing auction session for the equity cash market, which will begin in December 2026. The revised session will run from 3.30 pm to 3.40 pm, with specific phases for order entry. Moreover, the methodology for calculating settlement prices for derivatives contracts has been updated. Unexecuted orders will transition under new rules while maintaining time priority differences.

items.title: Market Trading Guide: Adani Power among 2 stock recommendations for Friday
items.description: Indian equities rallied as global technology stocks weakened amid AI valuation concerns and US inflation worries. Analysts recommend Bajaj Holdings and Adani Power for Friday, citing improving technical momentum, key support levels and potential upside, subject to market conditions.
